strategies.name: EURGBP_Carry
strategies.thesis: Exploiting interest rate differentials between EUR and GBP to generate positive edge
strategies.signal_construction: Long EURGBP when 10-year EUR bond yield is greater than 10-year GBP bond yield, short otherwise
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Uses interest rate differentials to inform trading decisions, unlike multi_asset_copytrader
strategies.fail_mode: Overfitting to historical interest rate differentials

strategies.name: GBPUSD_Momentum
strategies.thesis: Capturing momentum in GBPUSD to generate positive returns
strategies.signal_construction: Long GBPUSD when 50-day moving average is greater than 200-day moving average, short otherwise
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Focuses on momentum rather than mean-reversion, unlike multi_asset_copytrader
strategies.fail_mode: Decaying momentum due to changing market conditions

strategies.name: AUDUSD_CarryMomentum
strategies.thesis: Combining interest rate differentials and momentum to generate positive edge in AUDUSD
strategies.signal_construction: Long AUDUSD when 10-year AUD bond yield is greater than 10-year USD bond yield and 50-day moving average is greater than 200-day moving average, short otherwise
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Combines interest rate differentials and momentum, unlike multi_asset_copytrader
strategies.fail_mode: Overfitting to historical interest rate differentials and momentum

single_most_important_finding: The JPY-cross pairs are experiencing catastrophic losses due to the BoJ tightening in 2024-2025, which has inverted the prior LONG-USD-vs-JPY carry bias without a corresponding strategy update.
